title: Niagara Falls All Canadian Food Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Explore Canadian flavours with The All Canadian Food Walking Tour in Niagara Falls! Begin at The Flour Mill Scratch Kitchen Restaurant, savouring the iconic Maple Bacon Tree in the historic mill's cozy ambiance.

Continue to a Fallsview restaurant for a Braised Beef Poutine, with crispy fries, smoky meat, cheese curds, and savoury gravy amid panoramic Niagara Falls views. Stroll the scenic Niagara Parkway, capturing breathtaking photos of the Falls while our guide shares regional history and natural wonders.

Conclude at Beavertails on Clifton Hill, a Canadian pastry haven. Treat your sweet tooth to uniquely shaped pastries resembling beaver tails, customizable with various toppings.

Experience the beauty of Niagara Falls, with Canadian cuisine on The All Canadian Food Walking Tour. Arrive hungry, depart satisfied, and carry Canada's flavours in your heart!
